section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports findings from a single study (N=509) examining relationships between drive for muscularity, body appreciation, personality traits (Big Five), and BMI. Body appreciation was significantly and negatively correlated with both Neuroticism and BMI, while hierarchical regression analyses revealed that Neuroticism, subjective social status, BMI, and Extraversion were significant predictors of body appreciation (Adj. R² = .31).

section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports descriptive statistics and bivariate correlations from a single study (N = 509) presented in Table 1. Body appreciation was significantly and negatively correlated with Neuroticism and BMI (r = −.12, p < .05), and positively correlated with Extraversion and subjective social status. Hierarchical regression analyses examined drive for muscularity and body appreciation as criterion variables, with BMI, BMI², subjective social status, and Big Five personality domains as predictors.
